subject: Rocks
text: Go north from the room where you land to grab the rocks in the top-right corner.

evidence.quote: Go north from the room where you land, grab the rocks in the top-right corner, and kill the two creatures to open a secret door to the west.

subject: Secret door
text: Kill the two creatures to open a secret door to the west.

evidence.quote: kill the two creatures to open a secret door to the west.

subject: Polar bear
text: Kill the polar bear to open the secret door to the north, which leads to a staircase going back to the surface.

evidence.quote: Kill the polar bear there to open the secret door to the north. Go through that and you see the staircase going back to the surface.

subject: Hearts
text: Go into the room north of where you get the rocks if you need hearts.

evidence.quote: If you need hearts, go into the room north of where you get the rocks.

subject: Rocks
text: The throwing range of the rocks is VERY limited, so be careful.

evidence.quote: Please note the throwing range of the rocks is VERY limited, so be careful.

subject: Tink
text: One of the cave people, named Tink, will give you an Axe, your first regular weapon.

evidence.quote: One of the cave people, named Tink, will give you a Axe, your first regular weapon.

subject: Yum-Yum
text: The leader begs you to defeat Yum-Yum, who can be found by taking the western exit from the cave and heading north.

evidence.quote: The leader tells you that you must be the 'reliever' to come help these people. He tells you Yum-Yum killed a lot of people and begs you to defeat him. The monster can be found to the north. Take the western exit from the cave and head north to find Yum-Yum's cave.

subject: Medicine
text: Find the medicine in the secret room near the start of Yum-Yum's Cave.

evidence.quote: Find the medicine in the secret room near the start.

subject: Pillars puzzle
text: In the room with the three shapes on the pillars, walk in the order: Circle, Circle, Triangle, Square, Circle, Square, Triangle.

evidence.quote: When you come to the room with the three shapes on the pillars, you must walk in the direction indicated by the paintings of Pikzao that you saw in the cave....Just in case you forgot to write the order down, it goes -- Circle, Circle, Triangle, Square, Circle, Square, Triangle.

subject: Yum-Yum
text: Do not kill the hog in front of Yum-Yum or he will attack much faster and harder, making him much tougher to defeat.

evidence.quote: Do NOT kill the hog he has in front of him or he will attack much faster and harder, making him much tougher to defeat.

subject: Yum-Yum
text: Stay in the back and dodge bubbles when Yum-Yum is in the back row, then charge forward, jump over his bubbles, and fire axes at him when he moves to the front.

evidence.quote: You can't hit him in the back row, so just stay in the back and dodge bubbles. When he moves to the front, charge forward and jump over his bubbles, firing axes at him all the time.

subject: Tetrad
text: After discovering the four missing people in the cave past Yum-Yum, head north to find a Block that is one of the missing Tetrads.

evidence.quote: Upon arriving at the next cave, you discover the four missing people, including Shorty, Pikzao's son!...After they leave, head north and find a Block....After she's finished, Mike figures out the block he found is one of the missing Tetrads.

subject: Queen Cleopatra
text: Queen Cleopatra sends Mike out to get a pizza for her in return for promising to help find another Tetrad.

evidence.quote: Talk to MORE people, and find Queen Cleopatra. She sends Mike out to get a pizza for her....In return for bringing her her pizza, Celopatra promises to help you find another one of the Tetrads.

subject: Slingshot
text: In the room with the chest, jump on the tile on the ground to open the chest and get the slingshot weapon.

evidence.quote: In the room with the chest, you will see a title on the ground. Jump on it, don't step on it, and that will open the chest and give you a weapon, the slingshot.

subject: Porcupines
text: Porcupines change into a ball and charge, so position yourself to the left or right of where they stop at a wall and nail them before they can change again.

evidence.quote: The porcupines have the ability to change into a ball and charge at you. Get out of their way when they do. They always stop at a wall, so position yourself to the left or right of where they will stop and nail them before they can change again.

subject: Medicine
text: Clear all the enemies from all the rooms to open secret rooms, one of which contains medicine that can be collected again if you die.

evidence.quote: clear all the enemies from all the rooms the first time through so you can open secret rooms. In one of them you find some medicine....In case you die here, you can get the medicine again.

subject: Giant Scorpion
text: When fighting the Giant Scorpion, defeat small scorpions from the two holes if they get close, use the slingshot from afar, and move or jump when he flashes and makes noise to fire bullets.

evidence.quote: There's two holes in the wall above the overgrown stinger, from which small scorpions will come out from time to time. Defeat these if they get close to you and try to focus most of your attention on the big bug. Use the slingshot if you still have it, as it's range is longer....Every now and then he will flash and make noise -- that means he's getting ready to fire a spread of bullets. Stay as far away from him as possible and hit him repeatedly with your weapon. When he flashes, get ready to either move out of the way or jump.
